tasks.description: Persist the user's reminder hour through an owner-bound canonical profile command and read projection.
constraints: Forward SQL and focused pgTAP only. Return a valid unified git diff with exact headers and context in JSON; controller applies and tests. No live, HTTP, app, notifications, provider, entitlement or role changes beyond service-only RPC grants.

Implement public.execute_profile_reminder_hour_update(p_owner_id uuid,p_operation_id uuid,p_payload jsonb), canonical operation_receipts command profile.update, and read_owner_profile_settings(p_owner_id uuid) for the future GET /me. Profile writer accepts exactly one key reminder_hour_local with a JSON integer 0..23; reject null, string, fractional or unknown keys (22023). Require a permanent active owner and non-null operation ID, lock the owner row, validate owner-scoped exact receipt before a new mutation, reject same operation changed data or different command (23505). Reuse the established owner watermark function. No-op with a different operation may return the existing watermark; a genuine change advances it. Keep the default 9 for new users, no rewriting existing settings, never modify locale or entitlement; no profile fields supplied by other owners.

Return private service projection {preferred_locale,reminder_hour_local}; write response {profile:{preferred_locale,reminder_hour_local},watermark}. Read SQL NULL for absent, anonymous or inactive owner. Explicitly revoke on PUBLIC/anon/authenticated, grant only service_role, preserve existing /sync and prior migrations.

Add version-compatible coverage in existing auth_registration_profile.test.sql for default, all boundaries, 0/23, malformed types/keys, exact replay after later change, changed conflict, no local false success, owner isolation/no other settings touched, service-only ACL and new /sync profile hour/monotonic watermark. T083/T084 stay open until HTTP, client and live.

acceptance_criteria.description: Diff limited to forward migration and gate-covered profile fixture.
PostgreSQL clean and upgrade confirm private scoped settings, validation and replay.
